# Original Seamly2D AAMA exports

These unchanged original synthetic-data exports are Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
No GPL code or upstream sample is included. The matching native inputs,
expected metadata, SHA-256 hashes, source locations and full export provenance
are in `../../../../pattern/testdata/seamly/`.

The shirt has front/back pieces, size 50, total quantity 2 per piece, intended
one normal and one mirrored copy, cotton labels, 250 mm vertical grain lines,
diamond dart paths and slit-notch drawing segments. The default/hidden labels
omit material; hidden grain omits layer 7. Absence must remain visible to callers.
R12 baseline omits explicit units (the importer must warn about inference).
The metadata-patched R12 and R27 exports supply explicit millimetres.
